notes.title: 🚂 ALL ABOARD — UPDATED TRAILER ARRIVES!
notes.content:
[p]The Dreadline Express has evolved significantly over the past six months. To give you a sneak peek, we updated the trailer. [b]Take a look at how great it looks![/b][/p][previewyoutube="-j0t6KyaRlU;full"][/previewyoutube][p]You may notice [b]improved graphics, new NPC characters, additional story elements, redesigned core systems, updated illustrations[/b], and more. However, the sum of all the changes greatly exceeds what you can see.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Farewell generative AI[/b][/h3][p]From day one, the AI-generated art was just a placeholder. And now? [b]It’s outta here.[/b][/p][p]Enter Krystof—our [url="https://kykyn.artstation.com/"]brilliant new illustrator[/url] who has been bringing to life all the bizarre and beautiful ideas I throw his way. The card art has leveled up: more creative, more unified, and delightfully surreal when it needs to be.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323292/64b0125ebfc3d4d70345855091ef33e5cdf84414.jpg"][/img][/p][p]It's finally time to remove the "AI Generated Content Disclosure" from the Steam page.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]More steam![/b][/h3][p]It's not only Krystof. The Dreadline Express team has practically doubled in size over the last six months. Rest assured, I will introduce you the other team members soon. Stay tuned![/p][p]In the meantime, please help us gain more steam! [b]Tell your friends, share the trailer, and spread the word—it will help us greatly![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Until next time, the conductor’s watching. Stay curious.[/p][p]
- David[/p][p]
[/p]
